David, the king. His name also stands for his royal family.
Aram, called Syria in this English translation.
Judah: a name used for the ancestor, people, or kingdom.
Israel: a name used for Jacob and his descendants. It can also name the northern kingdom.
Ephraim: a tribal name also used for the northern kingdom.
Samaria, the capital of the northern kingdom and a name for its territory.
Damascus, the chief city of Aram.
Jerusalem, the royal and temple city of Judah.
Zion, a name for Jerusalem, its mountain, or its people.
Egypt, the country to the southwest of Judah.
Lachish, a fortified city of Judah.
